results.description:
Just 200 meters from the school gate, I find myself standing still, sighing as I gaze up at the sky.

Beyond lies the school gate, and I can't help but wonder who in their right mind would choose to place it in such a location. The slope in front of it stretches out like an unending ordeal.

Another sigh, quieter and shorter than mine, pulls me from my thoughts. I glance over and see a girl standing just as motionless. She's in her third year too, but I don't recognize her. Her short hair catches the breeze, fluttering just above her shoulders.

"Do you like this school?" she suddenly asks, not really to me, more like to herself. 
"I really, really like it. But nothing can stay the same forever. Everything has to change," she murmurs, her voice trailing off. "Can you still like this place, even then?"

"You just need to find what you love about it, right?" I chime in, catching her off guard. "You haven't really thought about what makes you happy here, have you?"

Back when we were younger, everything seemed simpler—everyone felt that way at some point.

"Come on, let's go," I say.

And together, we begin to climb the long, winding slope.

[Based on [url=https://key.visualarts.gr.jp/product/clannad/story/]the official site[/url]]

results.description:
It is the year 2022. 
Ushio Okazaki, now 22, sees mysterious "light" in the town of eternal snow. 
Ushio's search for the meaning of the "light" leads her to Kotomi's Superstring theory and Yukine's stories of the townspeople - and eventually, the vast expanse of the snow in an ending world. 
At the end of a never-ending journey, what does she see...?

This is a fan fiction of Clannad (available online), a continuation of Ushio's path.

results.description:
“A town on the coast…
 A life not lived…
 A lost love…
 A lonely child…
 A world of lights…
 New and fun things…”

The year is 1985. Okazaki Naoyuki hates his unfair life. A high school student, he has been readmitted to Ushinawa High after a year living as a shut-in. His neighbours, his classmates and his teachers all look down on him and he despises them for it. But, on his first day returning, he meets a girl on his way to school and his life changes in ways he never expected it could…

[From [url=http://clannadppvisualproject.wordpress.com/about/]Official site[/url]]

Today's Tomoya's 27th birthday and some people he knows are coming to celebrate it!

Ushio would have to be on her very best behaviour for Mama's wonderful tonkatsu and cake so she has to try her best to navigate the various conversations with Daddy's friends, family and potentially former crushes.

Hopefully it would go all according to plan...
